meta.name: competitor-pages
meta.description: Competitor page gap analysis — take a query you want to win and the pages currently outranking you, and produce a concrete brief on what to add or change to compete. Compares content depth and coverage (subtopics they cover that you don't), structure (headings, format, tables, media), search-intent match, E-E-A-T signals, schema/rich-result eligibility, internal linking, and on-page optimization — across your page vs. the top-ranking competitors. Use this skill whenever the user wants to know why a competitor outranks them on a specific query, what a top-ranking page does better, a content-gap analysis against specific competitor URLs, or a brief to beat a specific SERP. Trigger on: "why does competitor X outrank me", "content gap analysis", "competitor page analysis", "what does the top result have that I don't", "how do I beat this page", "analyze competitor pages", "SERP gap", "compete for [keyword]". For seed keyword discovery use /keyword-research; for a content calendar use /content-planner.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析竞争对手页面，生成内容优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道为什么竞争对手排名更高，以及如何改进自己的页面。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze competitor pages and generate content improvement briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know why competitors outrank you and how to improve your page.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会抓取你的网页与排名靠前的竞品页面,按搜索意图、内容覆盖、结构、E-E-A-T、Schema、内部链接等逐项对比,并给出「打败这个 SERP」的改进简报,包括建议格式、缺失的子主题、深度/媒体目标、需添加的 Schema 和内部链接。
howto.when: 当你说出「为什么竞品排名比我高」「内容差距分析」「怎么打败这个页面」等意图,并提供目标关键词、你的页面网址和 1–3 个竞品网址时触发。

say.text: 针对关键词「XX」,对比我的页面和竞品 URL,输出改进简报。
say.note: Claude 会抓取并逐项对比后生成简报。

say.text: 为什么在这个词上,竞品页排名比我高?
say.note: 它会检查意图、结构、E-E-A-T 等差距。

say.text: 我要打败这个 SERP,缺哪些子主题和 H2?
say.note: 简报会列出待补内容和可加的结构化数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches your page and top-ranking competitor pages, compares search intent, subtopic coverage, structure, E-E-A-T, schema, and internal links, then outputs a 'beat this SERP' brief: format to use, missing subtopics, depth/media targets, schema and internal links to add.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like 'why does this competitor outrank me', 'content gap analysis', or 'how do I beat this page', and provide the target query, your page URL, and 1–3 competitor URLs.

say_en.text: For keyword 'X', compare my page URL with these competitor URLs and give me a gap brief.
say_en.note: It crawls both sides and lists the differences.

say_en.text: Why does this competitor page rank above mine for this term?
say_en.note: It checks intent, structure, E-E-A-T, and more.

say_en.text: What subtopics and H2s do I need to beat this SERP?
say_en.note: The brief lists missing content and schema to add.
